card details microinteraction

Product·by @bodya_zhk·2026-08-24·inspora page·original post

What it is

Card details sheet (fintech): dark wallet app with a metallic silver Visa card peeking at top; tapping Details raises a 'Card details' sheet over a blurred, dimmed home screen - rows (Cardholder name, Card number, Expiry) each with a Copy button; the whole backdrop gaussian-blurs while the sheet is up, and dismissing reverses it.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a fintech card-details sheet - dark wallet app with a metallic silver Visa card peeking at top; tapping Details raises a "Card details" sheet over a gaussian-blurred, dimmed home screen; rows (Cardholder name, Card number, Expiry) each have a Copy button; the backdrop blur is linked to the sheet's travel, and dismissing reverses it.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Home: avatar + "Earn $50" chip, silver Spark Visa card art (metallic gradient, subtle noise), balance 5,293.00 in tabular figures with the ".00" de-emphasized, 4 action buttons (Receive/Send/Details/Scan QR), Transactions list. Sheet: "Card details" title, rows James Mitchell / 4113 1192 7819 4114 / 02-29, each with a Copy button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: bottom sheet with drag-linked backdrop.
- Details tap: sheet slides up from bottom over 400ms, spring damping ~28; backdrop blurs 0 -> 20px and dims in the same 400ms, interpolated linearly with sheet travel.
- Sheet settles ~55% height; backdrop blur holds while it's up.
- Copy button: label swaps to "Copied" (150ms) with a subtle check.
- Dismiss (drag down / tap outside): sheet follows the finger 1:1 while dragging - blur and dim release in sync with its position, not on a timer; release past threshold slides it away, otherwise springs back.

## Calibration
- Blur is drag-linked: mid-drag means mid-blur. This coupling is the entire premium feel.
- Sheet spring damping ~28 - settles once, no oscillation.
- 20px+ blur is heavy on purpose; the home screen should be unreadable behind the sheet.

## Reduced motion
Sheet fades/slides 200ms without drag physics; backdrop crossfades blur states.

## Don't miss
- backdrop-filter on a dedicated layer above home - blurring the content element itself clips at edges.
- Balance uses tabular-nums with the decimals de-emphasized (smaller, zinc-500).
- Copy gives immediate inline feedback; no toast.
